"''You say something, ''Master Obi-Wan''?—I can't hear you over the sound of all these enemy fighters being destroyed.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''}} [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used various customized '''[[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]]''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to lead the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|forces]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:SkywalkersDelta-7BDockingRing-TCW.png|thumb|left|180px|Skywalker's Delta-7B docked with a [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|Syluire hyperdrive ring]]]] {{Quote|Fire up the ''engines'', Artoo-Detoo—we're ''leaving''.|Anakin Skywalker, to R2-D2|''[[The Clone Wars: The Starcrusher Trap]]''}} These series of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were each painted gray and yellow, like [[Anakin Skywalker's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|his later]] [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]], and were armed with four laser cannons and an unknown complement of missiles. His droid, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], could fit in a socket located just fore of the cockpit of each fighter. Skywalker's fighter also had a [[Power harpoon launcher|tow cable]]. ==History== {{Quote|Ready the laser cannons, Artoo!|Anakin Skywalker, to R2-D2|}} At some point in time after the destruction of the ''[[Azure Angel]]'' on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] began using Delta-7B ''Aethersprite'' starfighters. Anakin first used his Delta-7B interceptor when he flew alongside [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]] in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. Later, Anakin once again flew the fighter alongside Obi-Wan's as they led [[Ghost Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Nexus Ortai]]. However, after both sides sustained heavy casualties, the Republic withdrew when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] brought reinforcements out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. During the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], the interceptor was severely damaged and R2-D2 went missing, believed to be destroyed. Artoo, however, was salvaged by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] captain of the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]]. Nachkt discovered the military secrets inside the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]], and planned to sell him to the Separatists. [[File:Anakins_Delta-7B_wreckage.png|thumb|left|180px|The wreckage of Anakin's Delta-7B from the Battle of Bothawui]] The fighter was later recovered and piloted by Anakin with a new astromech droid, [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]]. Anakin used the ship during the [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|mission]] to uncover the location of the Separatist [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], and during the ensuing raid on [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], he recovered Artoo as the station was breaking apart. Later, Anakin intentionally damaged the ship and used it along with the ''Twilight'' and a hyperdrive ring as a ploy to get aboard [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|Count Dooku's frigate]], with the intent to capture [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. However, his mission proved unsuccessful. During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], Anakin piloted his starfighter along with Ahsoka and her [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Together they faced [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] during the conflict. ===Destruction=== {{Quote|Where's your starfighter?''"
"''That ''thing'' ate it!|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and Anakin Skywalker|{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}}} Although surviving more than one precarious wreck, the fighter met its demise in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], when Skywalker flew into the hole of the last remaining [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]. Anakin tried to out-maneuver the beast, but his Delta-7B was struck by the creature and the vessel crashed into the rocky terrain. Skywalker escaped by riding on his astromech, R2-D2, using the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]{{'s}} thrusters to leave the wrecked Delta-7B behind to be crushed by the beast. ===Rebuilt=== Despite its destruction on Malastare, the fighter appeared once again when Skywalker used the fighter to find an escape pod containing a group of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] that had been forced to evacuate the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']].{{TCW|Death Trap}} It was later destroyed when R2-D2 was forced to use the fighter to destroy a [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]]. Later, Skywalker rebuilt the fighter, and used it to shoot down Ventress's personal shuttle along with Obi-Wan's Delta-7B.{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} ==Appearances== [[File:Jedistarfighter_detail.png|thumb|100px|Top view of Anakin's Delta-7B]] {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{Flash}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Clone Wars (audiobook)}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels]]'' *{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}} *{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}} *''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]'' *''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]'' *[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] *''[[The Clone Wars: Bait]]'' *{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}} *{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}} *{{TCW|Death Trap}} *{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} *{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}} *{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}} *''[[The Clone Wars: The Starcrusher Trap]]'' *{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}} *{{TCW|Tipping Points}} *{{TCW|Secret Weapons}} ==Sources== *{{SWPM|set=Clone Wars|cardname=Anakin Skywalker's Jedi Starfighter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw19b.jpg}} *''[[The Clone Wars: Masters of the Force]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Interceptor ligero Delta-7B clase Aethersprite de Anakin Skywalker/Leyendas }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Skywalker, Anakin's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor}} [[Category:Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptors]]
